main_text.head: OMISSA IN MISCELLANEIS.
main_text.p: Articulo V. de Prædestinatione, Aphorismo VII. pag. 43. Omissa Testimonia Scriptura ita suis literis respondere debent.
main_text.l: Ephes. 1, 5. Qui prædestinauit nos, quos adoptaret in filios per Iesum Christum in se pro benevolo affectu voluntatis suæ.
Matth. 11, 26. Etiam Pater; quoniam sic placuit tibi.
c] Psal. 81, 13. Permisi igitur eos fortitudini cordis eorum, & ambulaverunt in consiliis suis.
Act. 14, 16. Quia, præteritis ætatibus suit omnes gentes suis ipsarum viis incedere.
d] Actor. 13, 48. Et crediderunt, quotquot ordinati erant ad vitam æternam.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Reference letters a–l are marks in the list, not in running text. The OCR-style spelling "suit" in the line beginning "Quia" is as printed in the scan's reading; uncertain. Library stamp at foot omitted.
